commands.name: install-codex
commands.description: Install Codex for the current user on Linux or Windows. Skips installation when `codex` is already available.

commands.name: install-claude
commands.description: Install Claude Code for the current user on Linux or Windows. Skips installation when `claude` is already available.

commands.name: install-antigravity
commands.description: Install Antigravity for the current user on Linux or Windows. Skips installation when `agy` is already available.

commands.name: install-uv
commands.description: Install uv for the current user on Linux or Windows without changing shell PATH configuration. Skips installation when `uv` is already available.

commands.name: install-gh
commands.description: Download, verify, and install the latest GitHub CLI for the current user. Shows PATH guidance when needed.

commands.name: install-superpowers-codex
commands.description: Add the Superpowers plugin to Codex. Requires Codex plugin management, skips an existing installation, and leaves other plugins unchanged.

commands.name: install-superpowers-claude
commands.description: Add the Superpowers plugin to Claude Code for the current user. Requires plugin management, skips an existing installation, and leaves other plugins unchanged.

commands.name: install-superpowers-antigravity
commands.description: Add the Superpowers plugin to Antigravity from its GitHub repository. Requires plugin management, skips an existing installation, and leaves other plugins unchanged.

commands.name: setup-agents-codex
commands.description: Set up global Codex instructions, configuration, optional profiles, and packaged skills. Shows every conflict before asking whether to replace or back it up.

commands.name: setup-agents-claude
commands.description: Set up global Claude Code instructions, settings, and packaged skills. Shows every conflict before asking whether to replace or back it up.

commands.name: setup-agents-antigravity
commands.description: Set up global Antigravity instructions, settings, and packaged skills. Shows every conflict before asking whether to replace or back it up.

commands.name: setup-agents-project
commands.description: Add instruction files for selected agents to an existing project. Can update `.gitignore` and back up conflicting managed instruction files.

commands.name: setup-alacritty
commands.description: Build an Alacritty-based terminal setup on Debian or Ubuntu. Choose shell tools, fonts, desktop integrations, and default-terminal options; the existing Alacritty configuration is replaced without a backup.

commands.name: setup-kitty
commands.description: Build a Kitty-based terminal setup on Debian or Ubuntu. Choose shell tools, fonts, desktop integrations, and default-terminal options; the existing Kitty configuration is backed up before replacement.

commands.name: setup-windows
commands.description: Set up Windows Terminal, PowerShell 7, selected fonts, and terminal tools with WinGet. Backs up managed configuration when possible and reports each result.

commands.name: setup-wsl
commands.description: Set up selected shell and terminal tools on Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 under WSL. Uses sudo for system dependencies, backs up managed configuration when possible, and continues past optional feature failures.

commands.name: set-vscode-wsl-cwd
commands.description: Open a chosen WSL directory in VS Code and use it as the working directory of a managed terminal profile. Preserves JSONC comments, backs up changed settings, and supports `-Undo`.

commands.name: set-default-cwd
commands.description: Make Bash and Zsh start in a chosen WSL directory when opened from home. Preserves unrelated shell configuration and backs up changed files.

commands.name: change-grub-order
commands.description: Choose the default GRUB boot entry from an interactive list. Backs up the current GRUB settings before applying the change.

commands.name: setup-venv
commands.description: Add or remove a `venv` shell command that activates the nearest `.venv`. Keeps unrelated Bash and Zsh configuration but does not create backups.

commands.name: toggle-nopasswd-sudo
commands.description: Enable or disable passwordless sudo for one Linux or WSL user. Validates enabling changes and only manages the toolbox-owned sudoers file.

commands.name: create-env-alias
commands.description: Create a Bash or Zsh alias that activates a chosen `.venv`. Previews changes, confirms replacements separately, and can back up conflicts.

commands.name: bootstrap-python-from-venv
commands.description: Generate requirements, `pyproject.toml`, and `.python-version` from imports found in Python files and optional notebooks. Preserves unrelated TOML, stops on ambiguous input, and can run `uv lock`.

commands.name: create-project-template
commands.description: Merge the packaged project template into an existing directory without deleting destination-only files. Checks every conflict before asking to overwrite and does not create backups.
